summary: Pioneer Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing the acquisitions of Reiser Consulting Group and Wyndham Benefits, effective April 20, 2026. Terms (price, stake, premium) were not disclosed. The deals double Pioneer’s Employee Benefits division; Theresa Reiser will lead the combined division as VP, and Chris Goodness continues serving clients. No board recommendation or advisor named. The acquisitions are bolt-on, likely cash, with no material regulatory hurdles. Watch for future filings detailing financial impact or earn-out terms; risk-arb is minimal given small scale and immediate close.
